authority: Canonical human-facing Tools & Resources registry for the existing A–E research workflow.
scope_note: Resources support research tasks but are not research operations, rankings, endorsements, compatibility promises, or evidence that a calculation is converged or scientifically valid. Access, versions, and network availability can change.

task_groups.title: Find and qualify structures and data
task_groups.intro: Search structures, calculated properties, reference records, and reusable datasets; inspect provenance and access terms before reuse.

task_groups.title: Inspect, standardize, and build models
task_groups.intro: View structures, check symmetry, convert formats, and construct cells, defects, surfaces, interfaces, or molecular models.

task_groups.title: Choose methods, engines, pseudopotentials, and basis sets
task_groups.intro: Open the implementation and method data needed to define a calculation; software identity is not a convergence or validity result.

task_groups.title: Run, restart, scale, and record provenance
task_groups.intro: Manage calculations, schedulers, environments, workflow state, restart lineage, and reusable execution records.

task_groups.title: Analyze energies and ground-state properties
task_groups.intro: Inspect energies, bands, densities, fields, bonding, magnetism, defects, surfaces, interfaces, and related ground-state evidence.

task_groups.title: Study lattice, temperature, EPC, and superconductivity
task_groups.intro: Work with phonons, force constants, finite-temperature sampling, thermal transport, electron–phonon coupling, and superconductivity.

task_groups.title: Study excited states, topology, and transport
task_groups.intro: Use optics, GW/BSE, Wannier, Berry, topology, electronic transport, and quantum-transport resources.

task_groups.title: Validate, compare, preserve, and archive
task_groups.intro: Compare results, record uncertainty and provenance, package reusable objects, and deposit stable research records.

task_groups.title: Learn from manuals, tutorials, schools, books, and communities
task_groups.intro: Use primary documentation and maintained teaching routes; a tutorial example is not a universal parameter recommendation.

compatibility.deprecated_tools_adapter: The tools array contains slug-only adapters for contextual-navigation and software-bridge consumers. Resource metadata is canonical only in resources.
